name: jsettlers-exact-heldout-tiles
purpose: Held-out JSettlers table for planner_pv2_exact: planner_pv2_tiles alone vs three all-SMART JSettlers 2.6.10 robots on seeded games (base seed 20261116, 2048 games), paired by game name with the other policy's run (experiments/exact-heldout.json).
analysis: Paired with the other policy's receipt by scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.0125 --expect-games 2048 (see experiments/exact-heldout.json).
limitations: The patch file is GPLv3-derived and lives only in runs/external (never in this repo); its sha256 is pinned here. all_smart makes every locally started robot use JSettlers' SMART strategy params, including our extrabot's inherited fallback brain.
note: Predeclared 2026-11-09 before any game. Same server settings, patch v2, all-SMART robots as the tiles re-test; fresh base seed 20261116; 2048 games; only the policy differs. Launch with `uv run --with numpy` (both policies need numpy).
